titulo: Grading an Apology Video With the 6 Parts of a Real Apology
caption: YouTube only (a medio in 16:9, no Short and no Reel). What goes out is the YouTube title and the description.
descripcion:
What makes an apology work? Cella missed her best friend's birthday dinner, posted from a rooftop party the same night, and filmed an apology video. We stopped the tape and graded it against the six parts of an apology that researchers tested in 2016.

For the friend whose sorry starts with "you feel".

Chapters
0:00 Stop the tape
0:34 Part 1: The apology
1:58 Part 2: The grade
4:05 Part 3: Take two

The study: Lewicki, R. J., Polin, B., & Lount, R. B., Jr. (2016). An exploration of the structure of effective apologies. Negotiation and Conflict Management Research, 9(2), 177-196. https://doi.org/10.1111/ncmr.12073
Two studies tested six parts of an apology: expressing regret, explaining what went wrong, acknowledging responsibility, declaring repentance, offering repair and requesting forgiveness. Apologies with more parts worked better than those with fewer. Acknowledging responsibility counted most, offering repair came second, and requesting forgiveness counted least. Limits: participants read written apologies about trust broken at work, not a missed birthday; a voice and a face can change how an apology lands. The 1.5 out of 6 in the video is our own scoring for the joke; the study ranks the parts, it does not grade videos.

Cella's apology video is made up. Any resemblance to a real one is the genre's fault.
Voices: synthetic (ElevenLabs). Music and sounds made with code by NAOS.
Closer to yourself.
alt: A 5-minute video in 16:9 with two voices: Cella, soft and rehearsed, filming an apology video, and a deep, slow grader who stops the tape. At night Cella, a small amber doorway-shaped figure with two white eyes, sits on a bench in front of a big lamp used as a ring light, under REC and TAKE 5. Red stamps read STOP THE TAPE, MISSED: BEST FRIEND'S BIRTHDAY and SAME NIGHT: ROOFTOP STORY. Three part cards: The apology, The grade, Take two. Her captions read Sorry if anyone was hurt., Mercury was in retrograde., Sorry you feel that way, Jo. and Forgive me? Love and light. Stamps count EXCUSES: 3 and THERE IT IS; the comments read take your time, queen (her cousin) and Jo: viewed 2x. A sheet lists the six parts of an apology, marks my fault as number 1, fix it as number 2 and forgive me as least, then grades her: one half, five zeros and one full point, 1.5 / 6. In take two the ring light goes off, she calls Jo and says sorry, my fault, I'll book dinner, it won't happen again; the sheet scores 5 / 6. Jo writes ok. thursday. you're paying for dessert too. Cella asks Post this? and a stamp reads NO. Final cards: For the friend whose sorry starts with you feel., the study and Closer to yourself.
